local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local out = { valid = {}, hands = {} }
for name, path in pairs(player_manager.AllValidModels()) do out.valid[name] = path end
for _, n in ipairs({"kleiner","alyx","male01","female01","combine","zombie","police"}) do
  out[n] = player_manager.TranslatePlayerModel(n)
  local h = player_manager.TranslatePlayerHands(n) out.hands[n] = h
end
out.default_cvar = player_manager.TranslatePlayerModel("")
if IsValid(bot) then
  out.bot_model = bot:GetModel()
  out.bot_info = bot:GetInfo("cl_playermodel")
  out.bot_skin = bot:GetSkin()
  out.bot_hands = IsValid(bot:GetHands()) and bot:GetHands():GetModel() or "none"
end
out.count = table.Count(out.valid)
return out
